event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Singapore Straits Indonesia 01° 05.59' N 103° 43.70' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report September 2024
sources.text: Duty oiler on the ship underway noticed five unauthorized persons, with their face covered, in the engine room. One perpetrator appeared to be carrying a gun. Alarm raised, crew mustered and VTIS notified. Upon hearing the alarm, the perpetrators escaped without stealing anything. The coast guard boarded the ship for an inspection.
